thesis: The page is a Providence pattern book read from the gable down: every band ends in the cut edge of a real shingle pattern, and scrolling lays each course from the bottom up.

signature.name: Course-Cut Edges
signature.summary: Each band's lower boundary is cut in the butt profile of one shingle pattern (fishscale scallop, diamond point, hexagon, staggered square, clapboard drip) drawn as an SVG mask; a small legend chip on the edge names the pattern and decade, and on scroll the cut rows lay in from the bottom up, left to right.

palette.family: Painted-Lady Sage + Salmon Gable + Red Door

layoutMoves: Plate grid: each pattern section is a book plate, number top-left, drawn swatch on a 5-col margin, text on 7
Band edges are never straight: every tone change is a cut shingle profile, so the page reads as overlapping courses
Painted-house strip: color-by-street sits on a full-width drawn triple-decker elevation that recolors in place

motion.intro: Hero: the huge word FISHSCALE fills with the cedar photo by a bottom-up clip (700ms) while the scallop edge under it lays in row by row (400ms, 40ms stagger); text is readable from frame 0.
stories: lay: each Course-Cut Edge lays its shingles bottom-up left-to-right as the band enters (900ms, scrubbed on desktop, one-shot on phone)
draw: the pattern book plates draw their swatch row by row when the tab switches, like shingles being nailed
motion.hover: a 2px red-door hairline grows under links/cards scaleX 0->1 from left, 200ms
